All that remains is to defeat #p2144010#. You must end his schemes and bring peace to Maple World.

0.0: You've proven time and time again that you are the best the Silent Crusade has to offer. You're the only one who can complete this mission, #h0#. Go through the Crack in Time and defeat #b#p2144010##k in the Dimensional Crack. Show him what we're capable of!

yes.0: Everything rests on your shoulders now.

no.0: This is our most desperate hour. Help us, #h0#. You're our only hope.

0.msg: #p2144010# is still alive. The longer we wait, the more of his power he will regain.

Thank you, #h0#. Your courage prevented the darkness from consuming Maple World. Thank you for doing a great job with the Silent Crusade's mission so far. I'm looking forward to working with you in the future.
